Name: Perennial Flowers Compat
Author: hmkiesel
Description:
This is a compatibility version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13843]Perennial Flowers[/url] mod. The original flower assets conflicted with other mods, so in this mod I've updated the names of all the flower crops & objects to improve compatibility with other mods. The old version is being deprecated so please use this one!

Note: If you already have the old version installed, then removing it and installing this mod will cause any flower crops from the old mod to disappear, as well as any old flowers stored in your inventory. If you do want to migrate to this version, please follow these steps:
1. harvest all flower crops from the old Perennial Flowers mod
2. sell all harvested flowers from the old Perennial Flowers mod
3. go to sleep to save your game
4. delete the PerennialFlowers folder from your Mods directory
5. install the Perennial Flowers Compat mod


﻿This mod introduces 7 perennial flowers:
﻿Perennial ForgetMeNot
﻿Perennial Iris
﻿Perennial Lavender
﻿Perennial Lily - comes in white, pink, and yellow
﻿Perennial Peony
﻿Perennial Rose
﻿Perennial Red Spider Lily

Seeds can be purchased from Pierre's in any season for 100g each. All flowers sell for 150g.

The flowers will bloom through Spring, Summer, and Fall. In Winter, they will appear dried out/dead, but will still grow to full phase. They will never actually die, and their color will return in the Spring.

Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13926]Farm Anywhere[/url] to let you plant Perennial Flowers anywhere in Pelican Town!

All translations were submitted by me using google translate so may not be accurate/grammatically correct. If anything looks incorrect in your language, please post a comment and I can correct them!
